strings.name: Emma Stone
strings.summary: Stone moved from Arizona youth theater into Hollywood, developing comic, musical and psychologically complex roles. La La Land and Poor Things earned best-actress Oscars. She collaborates with auteur directors and produces films, with The Favourite, Cruella and Bugonia showing her range across mainstream and stylized cinema.
